changelog: DeskAI v2.14.0 (Build 67): Retasks. A computer task that ran clean is saved, and the same task asked again is repeated without the AI (answers and anything it writes are always fresh). See and delete them from the menu's new Retasks card. In a task's log and View only, retask lines (saved as a retask, repeating one, each repeated step) are violet with a ↻.
